patches.name: Desativar Blur do X
patches.description: Desativa permanentemente os efeitos de desfoque da Haze no X 12.30+.

patches.name: Disable Navigation Bar Contrast
patches.description: Disables system navigation bar contrast while preserving X's native Haze effect (Blur/Scrim).

patches.name: Fix Navigation Bar Haze
patches.description: Phase C2.4-C m2 guard isolation: B5.1 baseline plus read-only GraphicsLayer inspection through the navigation extension.

patches.name: Hide Post Reply Bar (Keep Haze)
patches.description: Hides the post reply bar while preserving the native navigation bar Haze effect (Blur/Scrim).

patches.name: Keep Bottom Bar Visible
patches.description: Keeps the bottom navigation bar visible while scrolling the timeline.

patches.name: Manter Barra Inferior Visível
patches.description: Mantém a barra inferior do X visível durante a rolagem da timeline.

patches.name: Preservar contraste da Barra de Navegação
patches.description: Mantém permanentemente a proteção visual da barra de navegação sem alterar o edge-to-edge.

patches.name: Remove Post Reply Container (Experimental)
patches.description: Removes the post reply content and tests a 64.dp minimum Haze container height.

patches.name: Remove Post Reply Content (Keep Layout) - Experimental
patches.description: Removes the inner post reply composer while preserving its parent Compose layout and native Haze configuration.
